Name: zTailored Perfection Configurations
Author: cocochanel
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Configuration files for the Tailored Perfection collection. Distributes pre-tuned 
[code]config.json[/code] settings for the collection's mods so users get the intended balance, UI, and QoL behavior without manually configuring 50+ mods through GMCM. Optional but recommended. Tested on Stardew Valley 1.6.15 / SMAPI 4.5.2.

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the full Tailored Perfection collection. Launch the game once to the title screen, then quit, so each mod generates its default config.[/*]
[*]Download and extract this mod. It mirrors the
[code]Mods[/code] folder structure.[/*]
[*]Copy the contents into 
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code], overwriting when prompted.[/*]
[*]Launch the game. Verify settings via GMCM. To revert a mod to defaults, delete its 
[code]config.json[/code] and relaunch.[/*]
[/list][b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*]Pre-configured settings for all GMCM-supported mods in the collection.[/*]
[*]Conflict deconfliction: UI Info Suite 2 Alternative set to defer animal indicators to Better Ranching and hut radius to Better Junimos.[/*]
[*]Tuned automation and UI layout across the load order.[/*]
[*]Single-folder install, no per-mod setup. No DLLs or assets — config files only.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]The full Tailored Perfection collection. Does nothing on its own.[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.2+, Generic Mod Config Menu, Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or compatible.[/*]
[*]Game must be launched once with all mods installed before applying this mod.[/*]
[/list][b]Shout outs[/b]
Thanks to the authors of every mod in this collection — credit for the underlying work is on each mod's own page. Particular thanks to Pathoschild for SMAPI and Content Patcher, the SVE team, and the GMCM maintainers.
